title: 汽車乙太網通訊
summary: 從網路配置到故障與重送證據，分開線速、有效吞吐及最差延遲。
summaryEn: Follow network setup through failures and retries, separating line rate, useful throughput and worst-case latency.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 通訊有效載荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Network payload bandwidth: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 通訊有效載荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Network payload bandwidth and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為交換器、控制流與時間同步。有效載荷率未含封包頭、間隔與重送；總線利用率需完整線上長度。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows switches, control streams and time synchronization. Payload rate excludes headers, gaps and retransmission; utilization needs full on-wire length.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：R=N×bytes×8×f；N=8、bytes=64、f=100 Hz；計算結果=0.4096 Mbit/s。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: R=N×bytes×8×f; N=8, bytes=64, f=100 Hz; result=0.4096 Mbit/s.
steps.failure: 平均負載低仍可能排隊超時；檢查優先權、突發與交換器緩衝。
steps.failureEn: Low mean load can still time out; inspect priorities, bursts and switch buffering.
steps.check: 有效載荷.4096 Mbit/s；另加協定負擔後才可與實際容量比較。 將此判讀連回交換器、控制流與時間同步的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Payload is .4096 Mbit/s; add overhead before comparing with link capacity. Relate this interpretation to switches, control streams and time synchronization and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
